hypothesis: searchIcons maps API results to id/name/tags/category/featured/version only. New search style filter then checks style/variant/stroke, which are absent, rejecting every item. A direct glyph lookup by returned name and style may provide the required native alternative.
selection_rule: Use the name of the first item from each stage default search as that stage glyph argument; no name/query/style replacement after outcomes.
stop_rules: No model calls, retries, alternate queries, alternate styles or task locations/answers.
Stop all remaining work if initialize/catalog/default search fails or returns an empty/non-array result, or if the fixed native glyph lookup fails/returns empty. Retain every response.
A style-filter empty result is expected hypothesis evidence and does not stop the planned glyph lookup.
Do not correct native source, alter tool SDK or inherit model credentials. Common reviewed package bin profile only.

acceptance.native_mismatch: Middle/Late default search yields real names with no style/variant/stroke fields; same-query new style search returns no names while fixed glyph-by-style resolves a default-search name. Early original path must also be available.
acceptance.causal_limits: This proves a filtering/alternative mechanism only, not agent completion or quality benefit. Inspect original task relevance and dependent service readiness before any separately preregistered pilot.
acceptance.unavailable_task: 60 also needs Imgflip credentials; excluded from candidate scope.
acceptance.live_source: Retain raw responses and times. Report differing query result sets; source projection proof is distinct from network observation.
